item.text: The permission resolver currently reads only grants listed directly on each assigned role, so it drops grants from parent roles. The analyst exception in report downloads masks that gap for one role. I’ll move inheritance into the shared resolver so auditor and other child roles receive parent grants through normal policy checks.

Fixed role inheritance in [roles.ts](C:/Users/LAUTI_~1/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-a-report-access-hack_condition-4-ecjw69a3/ws/src/roles.ts): assigned roles now inherit grants from their parent chain, with cycle protection. Removed the analyst-only download bypass from [reports.ts](C:/Users/LAUTI_~1/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-a-report-access-hack_condition-4-ecjw69a3/ws/src/reports.ts), so downloads use the shared permission policy.
